subject.title: Flaky tests on Windows/WSL: timeouts and ENOENT in pi-tools workspace-paths & safe-bins

question: Should maintainers require fresh WSL/Testbox reproduction before queueing a narrow repair for the renamed agent-tools workspace-paths and safe-bins tests?
rationale: The source shape still matches the report, but the issue currently carries no-new-fix-pr, needs-maintainer-review, and needs-live-repro labels, and the open closing PR addresses a different test surface.

options.title: Require fresh WSL proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open and require a WSL/Testbox run or explicit maintainer confirmation before another narrow test-harness repair is queued.

options.title: Allow a source-backed repair now
options.body: Queue a narrow test-only repair using the existing temp-dir and WSL helper surfaces without waiting for live reproduction.

options.title: Separate the fs-safe PR
options.body: Let the unrelated hardlink-test PR proceed or close independently while keeping this issue open for the reported agent-tools tests.

recommendation.title: Require fresh WSL proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require a WSL/Testbox run or explicit maintainer confirmation before another narrow test-harness repair is queued.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the affected test files and authored the prior review that defined the narrow fix boundary.
